# Cherishly

> Cherishly is your little memory companion. It helps you remember what matters about the people you love — their favorites, love languages, important dates, and the little moments in between.

Cherishly keeps person profiles, a shared timeline of moments, and gentle context for staying close to the people you care about. It runs on the open-source Menerio engine and shares its account system.
